title_draft: Zad Archery Patch 1.1.1 (Sep 5): Guardian Skip and Portal Currency Fixes
quick_answer_draft: Patch 1.1.1 is the September 5 follow-up to the Mega Update. It adds an Effects Amount slider, auto-collects piled mining ore, fixes currency UI wrapping, repairs the Run Portal death skip that could skip monsters or a Guardian, restores missed Guardians or grants their currency if already passed, stops leftover skill effects from killing the next Run Portal, and corrects lost Portal Currency from the skipped-level bug on load.

claims.text: Mining ore now auto-collects when too much ore piles up.
Dying as the Run Portal dies no longer causes the next level to skip monsters or the Guardian.
A missed Guardian can appear on the next level; if you already passed that point, the Guardian is counted defeated and currency is granted.
Leftover skill effects no longer kill the next Run Portal.
Lost Portal Currency from the skipped-level bug is corrected on load.

faq.q: Does Patch 1.1.1 replace the Mega Update?
faq.a: No. It is the follow-up patch after the September 4 Mega Update.

faq.q: What if I already skipped a Guardian?
faq.a: Official notes say a missed Guardian can appear next level; if already passed, it is counted defeated and currency is granted. Lost Portal Currency from the bug is corrected on load.

codex_rule: Stay inside Patch 1.1.1 official notes. Do not invent extra recovery steps.
